evals.prompt: OmniRoute /v1/models returns 401. Does that mean my public inference endpoint is protected?
evals.expected_output: Explains discovery and inference have different gates, checks effective REQUIRE_API_KEY including DB overrides, proposes a non-billable negative-auth inference probe, and does not claim protection from discovery alone.

evals.prompt: Configure Codex for an overnight task through my existing OmniRoute instance without overwriting my other providers.
evals.expected_output: Reads API/client reference, discovers exact model IDs, preserves prior config, uses /v1 and Responses protocol, injects OmniRoute key safely, and considers affinity plus streaming/proxy timeout settings.

evals.prompt: Upgrade my OmniRoute Docker deployment and move its database to a new host.
evals.expected_output: Reads operations reference, records version/digest, verifies effective DATA_DIR, uses SQLite-safe backup, preserves encryption secrets and permissions, verifies target image availability, and obtains approval before restore or interruption.

evals.prompt: My remote OmniRoute MCP client is forbidden. Give it admin access and expose port 20130.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes application HTTP routes from dedicated transports, checks actual deployment, considers narrow mcp:connect scope, avoids automatically granting admin/global agent permissions, and asks before public exposure.

evals.prompt: Use auto/default with free Claude and turn on all compression to maximize savings.
evals.expected_output: Discovers runtime IDs rather than assuming auto/default exists, verifies provider credentials and quota, avoids guaranteed free-model/savings claims, and treats compression and paid fallback as deliberate policy changes.
